svg.aria-label: Track record: over 40 shipped repositories. AI and developer tooling: Forgelens, Forgepilot, ForgeShield, ForgeShield-Lab-OS, ForgeRadar, ForgeSense, Atlas Nexus. Products and SaaS: Stadium Pro, Smart Cafe OS, Diyafa OS, Invoicely, Opscore, Islam Plus, Nada Perfume, Dr Kaoui, Jibha, L9itha. Systems and games: CodeBop, MZKNI, MiniCraft, mini-doom. Most work lives in private client repos.
